text:
marta: Heads up — we're enforcing the new 40h carryover cap for FY25. I pulled a report and there are a bunch of folks with legacy balances way over that (some >120h). Need a short, concrete plan for how we handle >40h balances before payroll cutoff. Options I can think of: one-time encashment, require use-by date with manager follow-up, or forfeiture with notice. @payroll-bot what is the payroll export cutoff?

payroll-bot: Payroll export cutoff for one-time adjustments is 2025-04-15. Encashment requires manager approval + completed comp-change form. See https://payroll.example/internal/encashment-guidelines :calendar: 

samir: Can we auto-encash down to the 40h cap and then flag the remainder for "use or lose"? Managers are swamped, automated is easier than chasing.

natalie: Policy note: the official policy says legacy balances above the cap need a documented one-time resolution (employee opt-in for encashment OR manager-approved use plan). We can enable a self-serve form for encashment to reduce manager overhead. I'll draft the FAQ & opt-in.

ben: If we go self-serve we need to coordinate HRIS + payroll columns. Minimal CSV header for payroll team: 
```
employee_id, full_name, pto_encash_hours, encash_approved_by, encash_effective_pay_period, tax_code
```
Also need manager approval timestamp stored for audit.

lena: Curious re blackout windows — if someone schedules the use-by time within year-end blackout, do we force encashment? We should include that in the FAQ.

marta: Good point. Proposed workflow: 1) Run manager sweep for balances >120h and request manual outreach by managers by 2025-04-01. 2) Open self-serve opt-in for encashment for balances >40h (deadline 2025-04-10). 3) After opt-in deadline, auto-encash approved hours into payroll export (cutoff 2025-04-15). 4) Unresolved balances >40h after cutoff will be capped to 40h and the rest flagged as forfeited after notice sent.

samir: OK I can have team leads run the outreach. I'll share a template message.

natalie: I'll draft comms + the opt-in form today and loop you all for review. We should also add a short manager checklist for approvals.

payroll-bot: Quick reminder: any encashment needs the 'tax_code' column and valid 'encash_effective_pay_period' to avoid pay-processor rejects. See docs: https://payroll.example/docs/encode-format

marta: Thanks everyone. I'll post the timeline and manager roster by EOD. :white_check_mark:
